build_BAN_model: build a BAN model by calling build() to initialize word embedding, text embedding, classifier, and bilinear attention networks
forward_BAN_inference: run forward inference on a BAN model with image features and text to get visual question answering scores
init_bilinear_attention_BAN: initialize the bilinear attention network with BCNet and FCNet modules for gamma rounds of attention refinement
init_text_embedding_BAN: create a BiLSTM text embedding module for processing question text in the BAN visual question answering model
init_classifier_BAN: build a WeightNormClassifier for the BAN model with configurable dropout and output choices for final prediction
